title: Reception - Chester
description:
Job Title: Receptionist

Location: Chester

Start date: ASAP

Contract Type: Temporary for 3 months

Working days: Monday to Friday

Working hours: 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM

Pay rate: 12.71 an hour

Are you a friendly and organised individual with a passion for providing excellent customer service? If so, our client, a prominent player in the automotive industry, is seeking a dynamic Receptionist to join their team in Chester! This is an exciting opportunity to be the welcoming face of a well-respected organisation while showcasing your skills in a vibrant environment.

Key Responsibilities:

As a Receptionist, you will play a crucial role in creating a positive first impression for visitors and callers alike. Your responsibilities will include:
- Greeting customers and visitors with a warm and professional demeanour.
- Managing incoming calls and directing them to the appropriate departments.
- Assisting with administrative tasks, including scheduling appointments and managing calendars.
- Maintaining the reception area to ensure it is tidy and inviting.
- Handling inquiries and resolving issues with a solutions-oriented approach.
- Collaborating with team members to ensure smooth office operations.

What Our Client Offers:
- A friendly and inclusive work environment that values teamwork and collaboration.
- Opportunities for personal and professional growth within the automotive sector.
- The chance to be part of a reputable organisation known for its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction.

Ideal Candidate:

Our client is looking for someone who embodies the following traits:
- Previous experience in a reception or customer service role is desirable.
- Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written.
- A professional appearance and demeanour.
- Strong organisational skills with an ability to multitask effectively.
- Proficiency in basic computer applications and phone systems.
- A positive attitude and willingness to help others.

Why This Role?

This position is perfect for individuals who thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy interacting with a diverse range of people. If you are keen to make a difference and contribute to a team dedicated to excellence, this role could be the perfect fit!

How to Apply:

If you are excited about this opportunity and believe you have the qualities our client is looking for, please submit your CV

Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity to shine as a Receptionist in a leading automotive organisation. Apply today and embark on an engaging journey in Chester's vibrant workplace!

title: Payroll Coordinator
company: The Business Connection Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Job Description:

Working for a well-organised and highly motivated Payments team, you will be responsible for overseeing all aspects of payroll processing, ensuring payments are accurate and made on time.

You will provide support to individual clients as assigned by the Payments Manager, while developing and maintaining effective business relationships and consistently delivering an excellent level of customer service.

Responsibilities:
- Process employee and subcontractor payments accurately and efficiently, taking into account agreed payment dates and payment methods.
- Process statutory payments and manage pension auto-enrolment.
- Ensure accurate and timely calculations of payments to statutory bodies and third-party providers.
- Confidently handle and resolve payroll, administration and tax queries raised by employees and subcontractors.
- Assist with the submission of FPS to ensure compliance with RTI regulations.
- Support the processing of employee and subcontractor timesheets and manage client invoicing in line with agency agreements.
- Provide agencies with accurate, relevant and up-to-date information as required.
- Ensure the wider business is kept informed of any relevant information or issues relating to agency invoices and receipts, or employee and subcontractor payments.
- Complete ad hoc administrative tasks as required.

Skills and experience:
- Working in a payroll role.
- Prioritise and manage workload.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong attention to detail when entering data, producing reports and carrying out calculations.
- Excellent numerical skills.
- Proficient in Microsoft Excel.

title: Legal Assistant
company: Siamo Recruitment a division of Siamo Group - Agency - Permanent
description:
Step into a growing legal practice where your organisational skills and eye for detail will directly support high-quality client service. This is a permanent opportunity for a Legal Assistant based in Chester in commercial property, offering clear responsibilities, a stable Monday Friday schedule, and a salary of up to £30k depending on experience.

About the Role:

As a Legal Assistant within the commercial property team, you will provide essential administrative and file management support to fee earners, helping to ensure smooth progression of transactions. You will be a key point of contact for clients, keeping them informed and supported throughout their matters. Your work will contribute to efficient case handling, accurate documentation, and a consistently professional client experience.

Key Responsibilities:
- Support fee earners with the day-to-day management of commercial property files from instruction to completion
- Prepare, format and proofread legal documents, correspondence and reports related to property transactions
- Manage incoming and outgoing communications, including telephone calls, emails and letters, ensuring prompt and professional client contact
- Maintain organised electronic and paper filing systems, ensuring all documents are accurately filed, indexed and easily retrievable
- Coordinate key dates, deadlines and appointments, including diary management and scheduling meetings
- Carry out routine property-related administrative tasks such as opening and closing files, drafting standard letters and updating case management systems
- Liaise with clients, solicitors, agents and other third parties to obtain information, chase documentation and provide updates on case progress

Key Requirements:
- Proven administrative experience within a legal or professional services environment
- Experience working within property law, either residential or commercial
- Strong client communication skills, with a professional and confident telephone manner
- Exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to produce accurate documentation and maintain error-free records
- Highly organised, able to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a structured and efficient manner
- Competent IT skills, including use of Microsoft Office and case management systems
- Ability to work independently as well as part of a team, using initiative to support fee earners effectively

If you are a detail-focused Legal Assistant with property experience looking for a permanent Monday to Friday, 9 5 role in Chester, we d like to hear from you. Apply now to take the next step in your legal support career.

title: Project Coordinator
description:
Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance

We re looking for a proactive and practical Project Coordinator Operations & Compliance to support the running and ongoing development of waste and recycling sites.

Salary £35-40k plus mileage

Location: North West You may be based in Chester, Buckley, Mold, Wrexham and surrounding areas.

There will be regular travel between company sites

About the Role

Working closely with the General Manager and key department leads, you ll play a central role in coordinating logistics, improving operational efficiency, managing site projects, monitoring costs and supporting high standards of environmental, health and safety compliance.

This is a varied, hands-on position combining project coordination and planning with practical involvement in site operations. From coordinating container loading and material movements to overseeing machinery installations, facility improvements and safety actions, you ll help ensure our sites operate safely, efficiently and cost-effectively.

You may have been - Project Coordinator, Operations Coordinator, Operations Project Coordinator, Operations Manager, Project Manager, Site Coordinator, Site Operations Coordinator, Business Operations Coordinator, Operational Support Coordinator, Environmental Compliance Coordinator, Health & Safety Coordinator, EHS Coordinator, SHEQ Coordinator, HSEQ Coordinator

Key Responsibilities as a Project Coordinator:

Operations & Logistics
- Coordinate daily workflows, collections, deliveries and processing schedules across three sites.
- Work closely with warehouse, administration, engineering and compliance teams to maintain efficient material flow.

Project & Facilities Coordination
- Coordinate projects from planning through to completion, including site upgrades, machinery installations and new recycling processes.
- Monitor facility, maintenance and equipment costs, helping keep projects and site improvements within budget.

Compliance, Health & Safety
- Support the Compliance & H&S Manager in maintaining environmental, hazardous waste and workplace safety standards.
- Coordinate site inspections, risk assessments, fire drills and toolbox talks.
- Maintain accurate safety records, track incidents and near misses, and follow up on corrective actions.

Reporting & Cost Control
- Monitor key performance indicators, including tonnage processed and recovery rates.
- Reconcile contractor, maintenance, safety equipment and logistics invoices before management approval.
- Prepare weekly operational, safety and project updates for the General Manager.

About You:

You ll ideally have:
- At least 3 years experience in project coordination, operations or operational support within an industrial, recycling, waste management or logistics environment.
- Experience coordinating workflows, schedules, goods movements or activities across multiple sites.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets, with confidence in reporting, data tracking and basic budget reconciliation.
- An understanding of workplace health and safety, environmental compliance and hazardous waste handling.
- Experience monitoring facility costs, maintenance expenditure or project budgets.
- A full, clean UK driving licence and willingness to travel regularly between our three sites.

Experience with inventory or operational management software would be an advantage.

title: Part Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Payroll Assistant

Location: Northwich
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Hours: 15 or 22.5 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days

We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Payroll Assistant to join an established and growing professional services business in Northwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who already has some payroll experience and is looking to broaden their knowledge, take on more responsibility and develop their career within payroll. You'll join a supportive and experienced payroll team, with plenty of opportunity to learn and develop your skills across a varied client base.

The Role

Working as part of the payroll team, you will assist with the accurate and timely processing of payrolls for a diverse portfolio of clients. This will include weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies across a range of sectors.

You will work closely with experienced payroll professionals, giving you the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, gain exposure to different payroll requirements and build your confidence in dealing with clients and payroll queries.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the preparation and processing of payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Process payroll information accurately and ensure deadlines are met.
- Support with payroll administration, including Auto Enrolment and BACS processing.
- Respond to routine payroll queries from clients, colleagues, HMRC and other third parties.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records.
- Assist with resolving payroll issues and escalate more complex queries when required.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
- Build strong and professional relationships with clients.
- Work collaboratively with the wider payroll team.
- Contribute to improving payroll processes and delivering a high level of client service.

About You

We're looking for someone with some previous payroll experience who is keen to develop and expand their skill set.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working in a payroll role.
- A good understanding of basic payroll processes and statutory requirements.
- Some knowledge of Auto Enrolment and statutory payments.
- Experience using payroll software; BrightPay experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Good communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- A positive attitude and genuine interest in developing a career in payroll.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Experience within a payroll bureau or accountancy practice would be advantageous, but candidates from an in-house payroll background will also be considered.

Why Join?

You'll be joining a supportive team where you can continue to develop your payroll experience while working with a varied client portfolio. The role offers flexibility and could suit someone looking to balance their career with other commitments.

Benefits include:
- 36 days' holiday including Bank Holidays and Christmas period (full-time equivalent)
- 5% employer pension contribution
- Option to buy or sell up to 5 days' holiday
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Life Assurance
- Enhanced maternity, paternity and shared parental pay
- Enhanced sick pay
- Referral scheme
- Paid volunteer time
- Long-service enhancements to pension contributions and holiday entitlement
- On-site parking
- Team social events
- Free fruit

Hours & Flexibility

This is a permanent part-time position, with flexibility around working hours.

Applications are welcomed from candidates looking to work either:
- 15 hours per week over 2 days, or
- 22.5 hours per week over 3 days

This could be an ideal opportunity for an experienced Payroll Assistant looking for a part-time position, or someone with existing payroll experience who is keen
